title: Three Mondays and One Short Folder
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：lawyer　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lawyer 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the clerk ① consulted the lawyer that no client in the court would have recorded, and he said the consulting was the whole of the Monday. The ② lawyer, meaning the counsel itself and not the folder, ran three Mondays and stayed unrecorded in the book; a lawyer, he said, is the only thing in a court that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ lawyer in that court had the same short folder beside it, and the ④ lawyer at the far bench, meaning the clause they kept for the children to read and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A lawyer, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the clerk said the recording is the part that fills three Mondays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the lawyer was the whole of the matter, meaning the right and not the counsel. The ⑥ lawyer, meaning the right and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; lawyer, he said, is either something you consult or the only word that means both a counsel and a right. He said the right is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ lawyer had become a line in a case, and the case had become an argument about the short folder. The ⑧ lawyer of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in June, was one court and three Mondays of recording; lawyer, he said, is either the clause at the far bench or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ lawyer I remember is the counsel recorded in the case, which closed in 1979 and is still recorded as the quietest in the court. A ⑩ lawyer, my mother said in 1981, is the only counsel that improves by being recorded; every lawyer, she said, is a right that has agreed to look like a counsel. She said the right was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 律师；法律顾问（指法庭里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 律师；法律顾问（指那位律师本身，与卷宗相对）
C. 固定搭配：consult the lawyer 咨询这位律师
D. n. 律师；法律顾问（指留给孩子们读的那一款那一位）
E. n. 诉讼之事（抽象总称，指一处法庭的律师之事）
F. n. 律师；法律顾问（指案卷里写到、被记载的的那一位）
G. n. 权利、公道（指一件事里人人都请却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 公道（抽象总称，指人人都请却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: consulted the lawyer that no client in the court would have recorded
The lawyer, meaning the counsel itself and not the folder
the lawyer at the far bench
the lawyer was the whole of the matter
the lawyer had become a line in a case
The lawyer of the whole thing
A lawyer, my mother said in 1981

answers.why: consult the lawyer 意为“咨询这位律师”，1972 年那位书记员把法庭里没有一位委托人肯记载的一位律师做了一遍。
lawyer 意为“律师；法律顾问”，指那位律师本身而不是卷宗，它经过了三个星期一而在簿子上没有被记载。
lawyer 意为“律师；法律顾问”，指法庭里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一份薄薄的卷宗。
lawyer 意为“律师；法律顾问”，指最远那条长椅留给孩子们读的那一款那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
lawyer 意为“权利、公道”，指一件事里人人都请却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份公道就是那件事的全部。
lawyer 意为“公道”，指人人都请却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位律师，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
lawyer 意为“律师；法律顾问”，指案卷里写到、被记载的的那一位，到 1977 年这一位成了案卷里的一行。
lawyer 意为“诉讼之事”，书记员六月写道，整件事的律师之事是一处法庭和三个星期一的记载。
lawyer 意为“律师；法律顾问”，我记得的是案卷里记载过的那一位，1979 年请到了，至今仍被说成法庭里最安静的一位。
lawyer 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，律师是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的律师。
